content.text: Deuces and Jacks and the Man with the Axe: 7-card stud variant where all 2s, all Jacks, and the King of Diamonds ('the man with the axe') are wild. Same deal as 7-card stud; many wilds create very strong hands. USA; dealer's choice.
American 7-card stud wild variant; Deuces, Jacks, and King of Diamonds wild. Name refers to the King of Diamonds figure.
From 2 to 8 players can take part, using a standard 52-pack. The game is best for 5 to 7 players; with 8 players the deck may run out towards the end of the deal.
Same as 7-card stud. All 2s, all Jacks, and the King of Diamonds are wild.
